ns2:section.sectionText: If you are a degree-seeking student taking a mix of campus-based and online delivered courses during the summer term, you should register for the course section(s) noted as CB. Students enrolling in these sections will be charged the campus range tuition. Students will utilize a combination of Moodle lessons, Elluminate-based discussion sections and office hours, and required e-Book access. Students are required to attend one of the two Elluminate sessions on Fridays. Two proctored hourly exams, and a proctored Final exam will be given, either on campus or at an approved location.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
